summary: The reporting path is statistically acceptable for the claimed production-candidate scope. Between-group comparisons operate on specimen summaries, not nuclei; the one-specimen-per-group RC4 evidence is explicitly descriptive; morphology, count, sampled exposure, and density outcomes are separated; missing observations are excluded metric-by-metric with reported denominators; exploratory inference includes effect sizes, confidence intervals, sensitivity tests, and family-specific BH correction. Commit-bound validation records agreement among the biological source CSV, spreadsheet, and PDF. No blocking statistics or reporting defect was identified.

findings.title: Pilot outputs are descriptive only
findings.impact: The RC4 evidence cannot support a KJ-versus-WT biological effect because it contains one independent specimen per group. This does not invalidate the production/reporting behavior claim.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/report/01_biological_results/data/biological_statistical_tests.csv:2-8 reports one specimen per group and insufficient_specimens for every biological metric.

findings.recommendation: Retain the descriptive-only language. For a biological study, prespecify specimen-level estimands and obtain adequate independent specimens per group before interpreting inferential outputs.

limitations: Focused pytest execution could not start because the managed read-only environment offered no writable temporary directory; the review therefore relies on source inspection and the commit-bound validation receipt for test execution.
The cross-format validator confirms exact primary source values in CSV, Excel, and PDF via a numeric contract and text tokens; it is not an independent pixel-level validation of every plotted glyph.
The minimum of three specimens per group is an availability gate for explicitly exploratory inference, not evidence that a future study with n=3 is adequately powered.
recommended_follow_up: For the eventual biological study, document a prospective specimen-level power or precision rationale rather than treating the software minimum of three specimens per group as a sample-size recommendation.
Continue generating the numeric contract and consistency receipt for every released report package, including hashes of the exact CSV, spreadsheet, and PDF artifacts.
If presentation slides become a release-controlled primary output, extend the consistency validator to check the PPTX against the same numeric contract.
